system.description:
Sparks of raw mana erupt and roar to life over a large area. Select a Magnitude 3 Area within range. On a failed Magykal Resistance, any creature within the selected area remains unaware of the impending danger and cannot use Breach abilities against this skill.

At the start of the next Phase, the selected area ignites in a small maelstrom of raw magyk. All enemy creatures within the selected area take damage equal to [2 x Arcana] and becomes Staggered on a failed Evasion.

Elemental Spark Effects:

  • Fire: Increase the damage dealt to [4 x Arcana] and all creatures who take damage begin Burning.
  • Water: All creatures who take damage are Soaked and also Dropped.
  • Earth: Increase the damage dealt to [3 x Arcana] and all spaces affected by this skill become Marching Terrain.
  • Air: All creatures within the selected area are thrown Airborne and pushed 5 Spaces away from the center of the selected area.
